title: Firehouse Breakfast Protein Bowls
subtitle: Roasted sweet potato, eggs, and chicken sausage in a savory high-protein breakfast bowl.
description: Roasted sweet potato cubes are topped with scrambled eggs, browned chicken sausage, salsa, and a spoon of cottage cheese. It is a savory, fully composed breakfast bowl built to hold real protein instead of just carbs.

steps.title: Roast the sweet potato
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss sweet potato cubes with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan. Roast 20–22 minutes, turning once, until browned at the edges and fork-tender.

steps.title: Brown the chicken sausage
steps.instruction: While the potatoes roast, brown chicken sausage in a large skillet over medium-high, breaking it into crumbles, 8–10 minutes until cooked through and browned.

steps.title: Scramble the eggs
steps.instruction: Lower heat to medium-low. Melt butter in a separate pan, add whisked eggs, and stir gently until just set and still glossy. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Hold everything separately
steps.instruction: Keep sweet potato, sausage, and eggs in separate covered dishes in a 200°F oven until ready to build bowls — combining them too early turns the eggs rubbery.

steps.title: Build the bowls
steps.instruction: Layer roasted sweet potato in each bowl, add a portion of sausage and scrambled eggs, then top with cottage cheese, salsa, green onions, and avocado if using.

stationWorkflow: Get sweet potatoes into the oven first — they take the longest of any component.
Cook sausage and eggs in separate pans so eggs stay soft instead of picking up grease.
Hold sweet potato and sausage covered at 200°F; scramble eggs closer to service so they stay tender.
cleanupNotes: Wipe down the egg pan while it's still warm — cooked egg sets hard once it cools completely.
Soak the sausage skillet in hot water while plates are served to loosen any browned bits.
leftovers: Store sweet potato, sausage, and eggs in separate containers up to 4 days; reheat eggs gently on low power.
Rebuild bowls with cold cottage cheese, salsa, and avocado added fresh rather than reheated.
